summary: Election Day with nothing to lean on: SPY +0.2% pre-market at 08:30 (flat at 07:43) because AAPL is -4% on its margin guide (memory costs) and PLTR -6% on slower bookings, while chips bounce again, harder than at 07:43 (SMH +3.3% at 08:30, NVDA +2.5%, AMD +4.5% into its report tonight, MU +4.6%). Yesterday the same chip bounce faded by noon and SMH closed 3.9% below its open; the theme is still cooling (SMH -19% in a month) and item 30 says gap-ups in a cooling theme fade. JOLTS and factory orders at 10:00, election results tonight, AMD and SMCI after the close, jobs report Friday. p_up 0.52, no SPY trade. No sniper: the names with news of their own are excluded (AAPL/PLTR reported last night, AMD reports tonight), negative (MRVL downgraded by B of A on day two of the Lumentum selloff, ORCL priced $20B of stock and notes at $116), or a read-through in a cooling theme with a 4.6% gap (MU on Apple's memory-cost comment).

Futures per CNBC/TipRanks ~05:40 ET: S&P -0.05% to -0.1%, Nasdaq-100 +0.4%, Dow -0.5% to -0.7%. Yields: 10Y 4.91% (+1 bp), 2Y 4.59% (flat). VIX not read (19.7 at the 11-02 close); DXY proxied by UUP.

Earnings reactions: AAPL 324.76 (-4.0%) after a beat (EPS 2.10, revenue $114.5B) with a December-quarter gross margin guide of 45-46% vs 47% expected, memory costs 'unprecedented'; PLTR 167.45 (-6.1%) after +96% revenue but total contract value only +6%. Both are first-trading-day-after-report names: no sniper, no intraday pick (rule since 11-01). AMD +3.0% pre-market reports tonight (excluded today and tomorrow), SMCI +2.3% reports tonight.

Chips: NVDA +1.7%, AMD +3.0%, MU +3.5%, INTC +3.3%, AVGO +2.0%, MRVL +2.5%, LITE +1.8% after Monday's second leg down (SMH -2.7% on the day, -3.9% from its open). Own news: NVDA negative (FT: cloud partners must keep Chinese customers under 49% of revenue), MRVL negative (B of A downgrade to Neutral $225, Cantor $225, Needham keeps Buy $300), MU positive read-through (Benzinga 06:31: shares rise on Apple's memory-cost commentary). No upgrade on a mega cap this morning in the news file; the 'Chevron upgrade' on a third-party list could not be confirmed (only UBS/MS target raises from 11-02).

ORCL 117.59 (-1.4%) after pricing $20B: 86.2M shares at $116 (about $9.9B net) plus $10B of notes; the overhang is now priced, Morgan Stanley Hold. 11-02 study (journal/research/FADES.md): equity offerings gap down and the day from 10:00 is a coin flip; puts lose; day two is not in the study.

Oil: USO +1.5% pre-market after -7.1% on 11-02 (WTI 96.7 -> about 97.5, Brent about 105.8); the 11-02 drop was read as a positioning unwind plus Iran-talk hopes, not a confirmed supply event. XLE +0.8% pre after -4.0%. Energy led October (+10% in a month) and is now -2% on the week.

Macro today: JOLTS (September, consensus about 7.1M) and factory orders (+1.2%) at 10:00, midterm elections (results overnight), no Fed speakers found, no coupon auction found (refunding announcement Wednesday). ISM services shows on Wednesday on most calendars (one lists Tuesday 15:00). Jobs report Friday 11-06 (in config/macro_events.json). Market prices a 73% chance of a December hike (Benzinga 11-02).

Down gaps >= 2% in the rebound_scanner universe: PLTR -6.1% and AAPL -4.0% (both post-report), none else. rebound_scanner and leader_follow are shadow-only; leader_follow's 09:45 pick is likely a chip name (AMD/MU/INTC), AMD reports tonight.

Dossiers: AMD reports tonight, so nothing today; the AMD dossier's lesson (mechanical rules rarely find its big days) applies tomorrow's reaction, which we do not trade. META -0.4% pre-market, no news of its own (publisher-terms pause is minor); S&P negative outlook from 10-31 still the overhang.

Why none and not put: AAPL's -4% is one stock (about -0.3% of SPY at the open, already in the pre-market price), the rest of the tape is bid, and election days have no base rate worth using. Why not call: the chip bounce is the second attempt in two days in a theme that is -19% in a month, and Monday's attempt failed by noon.

08:30 re-read (Webull extended hours): SPY 753.45 (+0.18%), QQQ +0.82%, IWM +0.5%, SMH +3.3%; defensives red (XLP -0.9%, XLV -0.4%, XLF -0.6%); TLT -0.2%, UUP +0.17%, USO -0.1% (the overnight oil bounce is gone), VIXY -0.4% (VIX about 18-19 by proxy). Chips firmer than at 07:43: MU +4.6%, AMD +4.5%, INTC +4.4%, MRVL +3.8%, SNDK +5.8%, AVGO +2.6%, NVDA +2.5%; AAPL -4.0% and PLTR -5.7% unchanged; ORCL turned to +0.7% (120.1) from -1.4%, the offering overhang is being bought. The second bounce is stronger than Monday's open, so p_up moves from 0.50 to 0.52, still none: Monday's bounce also looked fine at 10:30 (SMH +0.6% from its open) before it failed, and AAPL alone is about -0.3% of SPY at the open.

Not a sniper: the gap is over the 3% line for a heavy catalyst, memory is a cooling theme (-22% in a month), and on 11-02 MU opened +0.7% and closed 6.4% below its open

zh.summary: 今天是中期选举日，没什么可押的：苹果因为利润率指引差盘前跌 4%、Palantir 跌 6%，把大盘压住（SPY 盘前只 +0.2%）；芯片又在反弹、而且比 7 点多更强（08:30 半导体 ETF +3.3%、AMD +4.5%、美光 +4.6%），但昨天同样的反弹到中午就没了。10 点有职位空缺和工厂订单数据，今晚 AMD 财报，周五非农。看涨看跌各一半，今天不做 SPY。
zh.sniper: 今天不选。有消息的几只都不够格：苹果和 Palantir 昨晚刚发财报（财报后第一天不做）；AMD 今晚发财报；迈威尔被美银下调评级；甲骨文增发定价了但没有自己的利好；美光靠苹果「内存太贵」的话反过来涨 4.6%，但跳空超过 4%、内存板块还在降温，昨天开盘后就跌了 6%。
